item.title: Seeking Greenlight: Eternal Pharaoh
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Clinical

Central Narrative: SCP that is believed to be a humanoid anomaly in the form of a mummy. While having two other anomalies one being it's sarcophagus and the second being a collection of gold coins and a pair of curved swords found within the sarcophagus. Is also noted to be an anomaly that has the ORIA's attention.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: SCP is believed to know more on other anomalies that were native to it's region. Established as the anomaly is rather friendly and willing to communicate with foundation personnel, but shares little of it's own past or own knowledge.

Additional Notes: I do have a presentable sandbox draft to share should someone like to see it.
